thread:
maria.g: Heads-up  vendor onramp sync TOMORROW 9am PT. Focus: finalize 'waveflow' sequencing for H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi/B200, confirm embargo matrix, and agree SKU-freeze windows for marketplace listings.

oliver: Quick add  can we get each vendor to confirm a "waveflow id" and a SKU-freeze date so UI teams know when to lock listing metadata?

partner_bot: Reminder: meeting set 2025-05-20 09:00 PT. Vendor preflight form link posted to calendar.

devon: Infra note: conservative H100 Dedicated ~2025-06-16; MI300 NA late June (eu-west +10 days). Recommend a SKU-freeze 3 business days before announce per wave.

ravi-plg: From product: we'll expose a "compatibility_family" label (e.g., H100-family) and a "waveflow" tag in the SKU. Please ask vendors to provide preferred waveflow id + embargo_days.

si-liaison: SI request: canary image bundles, driver bundles, and a short integration window (2-3 day slot) per vendor. Also ask for air-gapped packaging requirements for on-prem SI installs.

press_ops: Press constraint: NVIDIA historically expects ~10 day embargo after driver sign-off. If vendor embargo_days >= 12 we'll need to stagger waves or move their SKU to a later waveflow.

anjali: Marketplace: we'll implement a soft-hide for SKUs missing SKU-freeze. UI will show a tooltip: "Pending vendor sign-off or embargo". Also need per-region flags for availability.

maria.g: Proposal: 3 waveflows: WF-A (H100 invite-only canaries), WF-B (MI300 + H200 wider onramp), WF-C (Gaudi + B200 economy lane). Each waveflow separated by ~2 weeks but conditional on embargo matrix & SKU-freeze.

devon: Add fallback rule to runbook: if vendor misses SKU-freeze, auto-route to compatibility_family and mark listing with WF-fallback tag.

ravi-plg: Action items for sync: vendors fill preflight (eta_signoff, embargo_days, waveflow_id, sku_freeze_date, microcode_embargo_boolean, region_limits), infra publish canary plan, SI upload integration calendar. I'll compile the compatibility sheet.

partner_bot: Preflight form: https://forms.redwood.example/waveflow-onramp-2025 (auto-reminder in 12h).

maria.g: Great. If you can't attend 9am PT DM me and we'll 1:1 the vendor. See you tomorrow. :calendar: :raised_hands:
